d.why: Perez is on screen in three Luke Cage S1 episodes (Step in the Arena, Just to Get a Rep, Suckas Need Bodyguards).

Shameek is on screen only in Luke Cage S1 'Moment of Truth' (later episodes show reused flashback footage and a photo), and that episode turns on him: he leads the robbery of Cottonmouth's gun deal, shoots Dante, and is beaten to death by Cottonmouth.

Squabbles appears only in Luke Cage S1 'Step in the Arena', and that episode turns on him: he is Carl's friend and trainer, framed to force Carl into Rackham's ring, and his murder is what drives Carl to expose the ring.
Anansi is on screen across Luke Cage S2 (episodes 2, 4, 6-10 and flashbacks in 11), and he is Bushmaster's uncle.
Arturo is on screen in Luke Cage S2 episodes 1 and 2, and only mentioned after that.
Cockroach is on screen in Luke Cage S2 episodes 1, 2, 3 and 5.
Dunbar is on screen in Luke Cage S2 episodes 12 and 13, at Shades's proffer and at Mariah's prosecution.
Drea is on screen in Luke Cage S2 episodes 2, 3 and 5.

Gideon appears only in Luke Cage S2 'I Get Physical' (mentioned in 'All Souled Out'), a witness Misty questions at an ICE facility about Bushmaster in her investigation; he is John's childhood friend, not family or a boss.
Higgins is on screen in Luke Cage S2 episodes 1 and 3, and his corpse is shown in episode 5.
Nandi is on screen in eight Luke Cage S2 episodes (2-5, 7-10).
Piranha is on screen in Luke Cage S2 episodes 1, 3, 5, 6 and 7.
Sheldon is on screen in nine Luke Cage S2 episodes as Bushmaster's right hand.
Stephanie is on screen in Luke Cage S2 episodes 1, 3, 7, 10 and in flashbacks in 11, and she is Sheldon's cousin.
Tomas is on screen in Luke Cage S2 'I Get Physical' and 'The Creator'.
Donna is on screen only in Moon Knight 'The Goldfish Problem' (mentioned in 'Summon the Suit'), but she is Steven Grant's (Marc Spector's) boss, his manager at the gallery gift shop.
Osiris is on screen in Moon Knight episodes 3 and 6 (a photo in 1, a mention in 5).
Wendy is on screen only in the Moon Knight episode 'Asylum' flashbacks (mentioned in 1 and 2), but she is Marc and Randall Spector's mother.

Barrie appears only in Ms. Marvel 'No Normal', a Damage Control agent under Deever who fires on Kamran and Kamala and passes Deever the phone; he is a subordinate in Deever's hunt, not its antagonist.
Zainab is on screen in Ms. Marvel 'Seeing Red' and 'Time and Again', and she is Owais's sister.
Beto is on screen in all six Secret Invasion episodes (as a corpse in the last).
Brogan is on screen in Secret Invasion 'Resurrection' and 'Promises', and is mentioned in 'Betrayed'.
The Stearns Skrull is on screen in Secret Invasion episodes 2, 3 and 6.
Ritson is on screen in Secret Invasion episodes 1, 4, 5 and 6 (a photo in 2, a mention in a short film).
The Lawton Skrull is on screen in Secret Invasion 'Promises' and 'Betrayed'.

The Poprishchin Skrull appears only in Secret Invasion 'Resurrection', a bomb dealer Fury and Talos question in one scene before Fury shoots him; Gravik's Moscow attack is the episode's plot, and he is no one's family or boss.
Rosa is on screen in Secret Invasion episodes 2, 3 and 5.
The Caspani Skrull is on screen in Secret Invasion 'Promises' and 'Betrayed'.
The Sagar Skrull is on screen in Secret Invasion 'Promises' and 'Home'.
Victor is on screen in Secret Invasion episodes 2, 3 and 5.
